dynamite:
dynamite comes in handy for clearing passages.
dynamite takes a bit of time to explode after you set it.
be careful! don't stand too close to it or you'll get a lot of smoke up your nose!!

Lettuce:
sheep love lettuce.
if you put any lettuce next to a sheep, he'll eat it.
when the sheep notices a lettuce, an icon appears in the lower left screen.
use lettuce to line a path.
